surfaces.glass_header: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10

animations.entrance: framer-motion initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}

demo_assets.overlays: 9 room PNG overlays toggled via React state (preserve existing functionality)

sections.name: Header
sections.design: Crystal Glass surface (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`), sticky top. Logo left, Nav links center (hidden on mobile), CTA right. Mobile hamburger menu.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.design: Grid split: Left 5 cols (Overline, H1, Subtitle, CTA buttons), Right 7 cols (Interactive Smart Lights Demo). Add a subtle, glowing orange ambient shadow (`bg-orange-500/10 blur-3xl`) behind the demo to make it pop.

sections.name: Tech Ticker
sections.design: Living Texture Marquee. Slow moving tech labels (Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Bluetooth, Alexa, Matter) using react-fast-marquee. Low contrast text (`text-zinc-700`) on black background. Wide tracking.

sections.name: Service Categories
sections.design: 3-column Bento grid. Cards for Residential, Commercial, Hotels. Each has a background image with heavy black gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-black/60 to-transparent`). White text, orange accent icon on hover.

sections.name: Stats & Social Proof
sections.design: Control Room grid (4 columns). Big numbers (`text-5xl font-light text-white`), small labels (`text-sm text-zinc-500`). Subtle 1px borders.

sections.name: Features
sections.design: Grid Layout with Tracing Beam or Neumorphic dark cards. 'Smart Living', 'Why InHaus', 'Premium Devices'. High contrast icons.

sections.name: CTA Section
sections.design: Massive typography. 'Ready to upgrade?'. Orange primary button. Generous padding (`py-32`).

sections.name: Footer
sections.design: Generous spacing (`py-24`). Deep black background. Big brand text (`text-[5vw]`), standard structured links. Contrast shifted from surface to base.

testing.rules: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`, `data-testid='nav-home-link'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion react-fast-marquee lucide-react`.
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
Preserve the Interactive Smart Lights Demo exactly as built (NoLights.png + 9 overlays). Position it prominently in the right column of the Hero section.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use the specified #0A0A0A base.
Ensure all cards use 1px subtle borders (`border-white/10`) and no flat backgrounds without texture or borders.
Apply `data-testid` to all actionable elements for automated testing.
For Partner logos, use simple text with `font-medium tracking-widest` or relevant Lucide icons if applicable, wrapped inside the `react-fast-marquee`.
